arxiv-1804-09847.title: Complex Moments and the distribution of Values of L ⁡ ( 1 , χ D ) L(1,\chi_{D}) over Function Fields with Applications to Class Numbers
arxiv-1804-09847.creator: Allysa Lumley
arxiv-1804-09847.description: Abstract . In this paper we investigate the moments and the distribution of L ⁡ ( 1 , χ D ) L(1,\chi_{D}) , where χ D \chi_{D} varies over quadratic characters associated to square-free polynomials D D of degree n n over 𝔽 q \mathbb{F}_{q} , as n → ∞ n\to\infty .

arxiv-2106-14708.title: Weighted multi-level deep learning analysis and framework for processing breast cancer WSIs
arxiv-2106-14708.creator: Peter Bokor, Lukas Hudec, Ondrej Fabian, Wanda Benesova
arxiv-2106-14708.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Peter Bokor, Lukas Hudec, Ondrej Fabian, Wanda Benesova. Prevention and early diagnosis of breast cancer (BC) is an essential prerequisite for the selection of proper treatment. The substantial pressure due to the increase of demand for faster and more precise diagnostic results drives for automatic solutions. In the past decade, deep learning techniques have demonstrated their power over several domains, and Computer-Aided (CAD) diagnostic became one of them.

arxiv-2302-07409.title: Quantum Learning Theory Beyond Batch Binary Classification
arxiv-2302-07409.creator: Preetham Mohan, Ambuj Tewari
arxiv-2302-07409.description: Abstract Arunachalam and de Wolf 2018 showed that the sample complexity of quantum batch learning of boolean functions, in the realizable and agnostic settings, has the same form and order as the corresponding classical sample complexities. In this paper, we extend this, ostensibly surprising, message to batch multiclass learning, online boolean learning, and online multiclass learning.

arxiv-2305-05138.title: Read, Diagnose and Chat: Towards Explainable and Interactive LLMs-Augmented Depression Detection in Social Media
arxiv-2305-05138.creator: Wei Qin, Zetong Chen, Lei Wang, Yunshi Lan, Weijieying Ren, Richang Hong
arxiv-2305-05138.description: Abstract . Depression detection based on social media content has received increasing attention, as it allows for early diagnosis before the user’s psychological state deteriorates. Although traditional methods of depression detection can provide a classification of whether the user is depressed or not, they cannot provide human-like explanations and interactions.

arxiv-2305-15870.title: Robust asymptotic observer of motion states with nonlinear friction Author accepted manuscript (IFAC World Congress 2023)
arxiv-2305-15870.creator: Michael Ruderman
arxiv-2305-15870.description: Abstract This paper revisits the previously proposed linear asymptotic observer of the motion state variables with nonlinear friction and provides a robust design suitable for both, transient presliding and steady-state sliding phases of the relative motion. The class of motion systems with the only measurable output displacement is considered.

arxiv-2402-15966.title: Data-driven micromorphic mechanics for materials with strain localization Note: Postprint version. Note: Published version: J. Ulloa, L. Stainier, M. Ortiz, and J.E. Andrade. Data-driven micromorphic mechanics for materials with strain localization. Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineer
arxiv-2402-15966.creator: Jacinto Ulloa, Laurent Stainier, Michael Ortiz, José E. Andrade
arxiv-2402-15966.description: Abstract This paper explores the role of generalized continuum mechanics, and the feasibility of model-free data-driven computing approaches thereof, in solids undergoing failure by strain localization. Specifically, we set forth a methodology for capturing material instabilities using data-driven mechanics without prior information regarding the failure mode.

arxiv-2406-02009.title: Phonetic Enhanced Language Modeling for Text-to-Speech Synthesis
arxiv-2406-02009.creator: Kun Zhou, Shengkui Zhao, Yukun Ma, Chong Zhang, Hao Wang, Dianwen Ng, Chongjia Ni, Nguyen Trung Hieu, Jia Qi Yip, Bin Ma
arxiv-2406-02009.description: Abstract Recent language model-based text-to-speech (TTS) frameworks demonstrate scalability and in-context learning capabilities. However, they suffer from robustness issues due to the accumulation of errors in speech unit predictions during autoregressive language modeling. In this paper, we propose a phonetic enhanced language modeling method to improve the performance of TTS models.

arxiv-2506-17626.title: Local feature filtering for scalable and well-conditioned Random Feature Methods
arxiv-2506-17626.creator: Jan Willem van Beek, Victorita Dolean, Ben Moseley
arxiv-2506-17626.description: Abstract In recent years, machine learning has emerged as a powerful tool for solving partial differential equations (PDEs), with randomized neural networks showing remarkable potential. These networks, typically shallow, differ from conventional approaches by randomizing all parameters except those in the final layer. Notably, by integrating techniques inspired by domain decomposition, they achieve improved local accuracy and computational efficiency.

arxiv-2507-22414.description: Abstract . Large Language Model (LLM) agents autonomously use external tools on top of one or more LLMs to accomplish specific tasks. Lately LLM agents for software engineering and coding tasks have become popular. These agents can benefit from the use of program analysis tools working on program representations.

openalex-w7204107965.creator: Fabrício da Cunha Moraes, LIVIA MARIA DA SILVA, Jailene Mercedes Ibáñez Herrera, Guilherme Augusto Melo de Oliveira, Flávio Rui Bezerra de Souza Júnior

openalex-w7204107965.description: A depressão pós-parto frequentemente representa continuidade ou intensificação de sintomas iniciados na gestação, tornando o pré-natal uma oportunidade para reconhecimento e intervenção precoces. Esta revisão narrativa analisou o papel do rastreamento pré-natal na identificação...

pmc-10647514.title: Challenges in Sheltering Seized Animals from Hoarders from a One Welfare Perspective
pmc-10647514.creator: Paola Fossati, Jacquie Rand
pmc-10647514.description: Simple SummaryAnimal hoarding is a serious behavioral issue that overwhelms hoarders and impacts many animals, causing them to suffer in inadequate, unsanitary, and hidden environments. It poses significant challenges to animal welfare, frequently leading to mistreatment, along with threats to human health. When such an obsessive accumulation of animals is discovered, exposing their harmful condition, there are not perfect solutions.

pmc-10879896.title: Hépatites Delta en Afrique: particularités épidémiologiques et cliniques
pmc-10879896.creator: Françoise LUNEL FABIANI, Ahmed EL BARA, Cheikh Tijani HAMED, Hélène LE GUILLOU GUILLEMETTE
pmc-10879896.description: RésuméEn 2022, l'Organisation mondiale de la santé (OMS) estimait que les infections par le virus de l'hépatite B (VHB) avaient causé 1,5 millions de décès, imputables pour la plupart aux complications des infections chroniques, cirrhose et carcinome hépatocellulaire (CHC). Malgré la disponibilité d'un vaccin, 296 millions de personnes étaient chroniquement infectées en 2019.

pmc-11371449.title: Successful Preoperative Radiotherapy for Neglected Shoulder Liposarcoma: A Retrospective Case Report
pmc-11371449.creator: Camilla Linhart, Craig MacLeod
pmc-11371449.description: This study examines a unique case of a 61-year-old male with a 5-year history of a progressively growing mass above his right shoulder, diagnosed as a dedifferentiated pleomorphic liposarcoma. Using computerized tomography-guided core needle biopsy, the tumour was identified as intermediate to high grade. Surgical removal required preoperative radiotherapy to reduce the size of the tumour.

pmc-11410870.title: A patient with positive anti‐IFN‐γ autoantibody and monoclonal gammaglobulinemia masquerading as multiple myeloma: Case report and literature review
pmc-11410870.creator: Ran An, Zhiyin Liu, Fangxiu Luo, Zeying Yan, Ying Wang, Haimin Sun, Jie Tian, Yu Chen, Yubao Chen
pmc-11410870.description: Key Clinical MessageAdult‐onset immunodeficiency (AOID) is an emerging acquired immunodeficiency, characterized by multiple opportunistic infections including non‐tuberculous mycobacterium (NTM) due to the presence of anti‐IFN‐γ autoantibody (AIGA). This case highlights the challenges of accurate diagnosis of monoclonal gammaglobulinemia with NTM infection and favorable outcomes of anti‐plasma cell therapy in AOID.

pmc-11590820.title: Assessment of bleeding events in patients receiving DOACs with or without statins to treat venous thromboembolism: insights from the RIETE registry
pmc-11590820.creator: Rosaria Del Giorno, Lucia Mazzolai, Sanjiv Keller, Carmine Siniscalchi, Luciano Lopez-Jimenez, Aitor Ballaz, Ana Cristina Montenegro, Remedios Otero, Farid Rashidi, Manuel Monreal, The RIETE Investigators
pmc-11590820.description: AbstractObjectiveTo evaluate the impact of coadministering statins with direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs) on the risk of major bleeding events in patients with venous thromboembolism (VTE).DesignObservational cohort analysis based on a multicentre international registry.SettingData were extracted from the Registro Informatizado de Enfermedad TromboEmbolica Registry, which involves 205 centres across 27 countries.

pmc-12384301.title: Perspectives on registered nurse retention in nursing homes in Korea: A qualitative study
pmc-12384301.creator: Jiyeon Lee
pmc-12384301.description: PurposeThis study aimed to understand the factors influencing registered nurses’ (RNs) intentions to remain employed in their current nursing homes (NHs).MethodsData were collected through individual in-depth interviews with 10 RNs in five Korean NHs from May 1 to May 31, 2024, and analyzed using thematic analysis.

pmc-12473786.title: Multi-Performance Evolution and Elasto-Plastic Damage Modeling of Basalt Fiber-Reinforced EPS Geopolymer Lightweight Concrete
pmc-12473786.creator: Feng Liang, Qingshun Yang, Jutao Tao
pmc-12473786.description: To elucidate the multi-performance evolution mechanisms of basalt fiber-reinforced lightweight expanded polystyrene geopolymer concrete (LEGC), a two-tiered investigation was conducted. In the first part, a series of LEGC mixtures with varying volume fractions of EPS (10–40%) and basalt fiber (BF) (0.4–0.8%) were designed. Experimental tests were carried out to evaluate density, flowability, compressive strength, flexural strength, and splitting tensile strength.

pmc-12609002.title: Bone Quality Beyond DXA in People Living with HIV: A Systematic Review of HR-pQCT, TBS, Microindentation, and Vertebral Fractures
pmc-12609002.creator: David Vladut Razvan, Ovidiu Rosca, Felix Bratosin, Vlad Predescu, Silviu Valentin Vlad, Adrian Vlad, Giuseppe Vittorio De Socio
pmc-12609002.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background and Objectives: People living with HIV (PLWH) have excess fragility fractures not fully explained by areal DXA. We reviewed bone “quality” in PLWH—microarchitecture, estimated strength, tissue-level properties—and vertebral fractures (VFs). Methods: PRISMA-conform systematic review (2000–2025) of randomized, cohort, and cross-sectional studies assessing HR-pQCT (±finite-element analysis), trabecular bone score (TBS), impact microindentation (BMSi), femoral QCT/MRI, and VF imaging (DXA-VFA or radiography). Risk of bias used ROBINS-I (non-randomized) and RoB 2 (randomized/switch).

pmc-12640045.title: Preparation, physicochemical properties, and in vitro digestion characteristics of coconut diacylglycerol oil
pmc-12640045.creator: Jiao-jiao Yin, Xin-feng Li, Shu Wang, He Huang, Zhuo-long Guan, Xing-he Zhang, Wu Zhong, Pan Gao, Dong-ping He
pmc-12640045.description: Coconut oil (CO), rich in medium-chain fatty acids and lauric acid, has gained popularity for its functional benefits. This study focused on the preparation and analysis of coconut diacylglycerol oil (CO-DAG), exploring its physicochemical properties and in vitro digestion characteristics, providing a theoretical basis for its application in functional oil.

pmc-13192121.title: Development and validation of deprescribing algorithms for kidney failure using consensus development methodology
pmc-13192121.creator: Amani Zidan, Kheloud Awad, Safeya Habib, Noor Alsalemi, Hager Elgeed, Abdullah Hamad, Hassan Al-Malki, Mohamad Alkadi, Mohamed Elesnawi, Fatima Babiker, Rania Ibrahim, Muhammad Abdul Hadi, Ahmed Awaisu
pmc-13192121.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundPatients with kidney failure (KF) are at high risk of inappropriate polypharmacy; however, this can be mitigated through deprescribing. While several evidence-based deprescribing guidelines exist for various patient populations, their applicability and utility in KF settings remain limited.AimThis study aimed to adapt existing evidence on deprescribing in KF to develop practical deprescribing algorithms that support clinicians in implementing deprescribing interventions in KF care.MethodsAvailable evidence about deprescribing in KF was reviewed, and local prescribing trends among KF patients were explored.

pmc-13325125.title: Quantification of Human Cardiac Ion Channels by Parallel Reaction Monitoring and In-Sample Calibration
pmc-13325125.creator: Soroush Torkamannejad, Hoi-ying Yip, Bingyun Sun

pmc-13396956.title: Health-care provider compliance with a revised Plasmodium vivax radical cure algorithm incorporating tafenoquine and quantitative G6PD testing in the Peruvian Amazon: a prospective observational study
pmc-13396956.creator: Elisa Vidal-Cardenas, Catharine I De Freitas-Vidal, Veronica Soto-Calle, Hugo Rodríguez-Ferrucci, Wilma Casanova, Ivan Condori-Lizarraga, Stephan Duparc, Elodie Jambert, Melanie Larson, Heike Huegel, Thy Do, Paula Alejandra Burela, Marcus Lacerda, Alejandro Llanos-Cuentas
pmc-13396956.description: SummaryBackgroundPlasmodium vivax relapse remains a key barrier to malaria elimination in Latin America. Historically, radical cure relied on multi-day primaquine regimens, often without prior glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) testing. In November 2024, WHO issued a recommendation specific to South America for radical cure with primaquine or single-dose tafenoquine after testing G6PD activity.

pmc-13593566.title: Experimental evidence of a biological soil crust degradation climate warming amplification feedback
pmc-13593566.creator: William K. Smith, Miguel L. Villarreal, Cara Lauria, Willliam A. Rutherford, Stefanie Herrmann, Victoria Scholl, Armin Howell, Mostafa Javadian, Fujiang Ji, Fangyue Zhang, Matthew A. Burgess, Raymond Kokaly, Benjamin Poulter, Sasha C. Reed
pmc-13593566.description: Biological soil crusts – photosynthetic communities of cyanobacteria, lichens, and/or mosses living on soil surfaces – represent about 12% of the global land surface, yet their role in climate mitigation remains uncertain. Here we address this knowledge gap by integrating multiscale remote sensing techniques within a unique long-term climate manipulation experiment.
